command: Saccharomyces cerevisiae Yar1 promotes RNA polymerase II transcription or belongs to the MBF or SBF transcription complexes. Adjudicate these claims independently of DNA-binding transcription-activator activity and established Rps3 chaperoning. Lack of an APSES DNA-binding domain does not exclude non-DNA-binding recruitment or complex subunit roles, as illustrated by Swi6/Cdc10. Evaluate primary complex and regulatory evidence and phylogenetic source placement, distinguishing direct contribution from indirect effects of ribosome biogenesis. The existing DNA-binding-activator report does not resolve these separate claims.
